name: Planet market activity is taxable
description: Verifies that a successful planet.market.sell command durably records one taxable market activity row.

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_goods WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');
DELETE FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'planet' AND entity_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');
DELETE FROM citadels WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');

tests.name: Remove prior isolated planet tax policies and assessments

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_tax_policies WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');
DELETE FROM planet_tax_assessments WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');
DELETE FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');
DELETE FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test';

tests.name: Grant genesis device for planet creation

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET genesis = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'taxable_activity_seller');

INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity) VALUES ('planet', @{test_planet_id}, 'ORE', 100) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO citadels (planet_id, level, treasury, owner_id) VALUES (@{test_planet_id}, 1, 500, @{taxable_activity_seller_player_id}) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level = 1, owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id;
UPDATE planets SET citadel_level = 1 WHERE planet_id = @{test_planet_id};

tests.name: Sell planet ORE through the client API
Verify one durable taxable activity row was recorded

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE planet_id = @{test_planet_id} AND activity_type = 'market_trade' AND commodity_code = 'ORE' AND quantity = 10 AND idempotency_key LIKE 'planet-trade:sell:%';
